lines.text: A canal in Chennai was dug by people who were starving.
lines.caps: a canal in *Chennai | dug by people | who were *starving.

lines.text: In eighteen seventy six the monsoon failed, and famine spread across the Madras Presidency.
Across India, millions died. Estimates run from about five million to over nine million.
lines.caps: across India | *millions died | about *five million | to over *nine.

lines.text: Relief came with a condition. To be fed, you had to work.
lines.caps: relief came with | a *condition | to be fed | you had to *work.

lines.text: In early eighteen seventy seven, the daily relief wage for a man was cut to one pound of grain, and one anna.
lines.caps: in early *1877 | the wage was cut | to *one pound | of grain.

lines.text: Women and children got less. Even the sanitary commissioner of Madras argued for at least one and a half pounds.
lines.caps: women and children | got *less | even the *sanitary commissioner | argued for *more.

lines.text: One of these relief works was a canal through the city of Madras.
lines.caps: one relief work | was a *canal | through *Madras.

lines.text: Workers dug a link about eight kilometres long, joining the Adyar river to the Cooum.
lines.caps: a link about | *8 kilometres | joining the *Adyar | to the *Cooum.

lines.text: It was ordered by the Governor, the Duke of Buckingham.
lines.caps: ordered by | the *Governor | the Duke of *Buckingham.

lines.text: And the canal took his name. The diggers left no names that we know of.
lines.caps: the canal took | *his name | the *diggers | left *no names.

lines.text: Joined to older stretches, the Buckingham Canal runs about seven hundred and ninety six kilometres along the coast.

lines.text: Today, in Chennai, long stretches lie choked and neglected.
lines.caps: today in Chennai | long stretches | lie *choked.

lines.text: So the next time you cross it, remember who dug it.
